title: Buffalo extends emerald shiner passage along 700 feet of Niagara River seawall

This effort is part of a significant multi-million-dollar restoration project for the Niagara River Area, alongside transforming nearby industrial slips into crucial shallow-water habitats, all geared towards rectifying historic environmental harm in western New York.

title: Utah boy, 13, spends 300 hours 3D-printing wheelchair for toddler
